never_call_note: never_call means CARRIED AND CALLABLE by an app, and never invoked BY THE DIFFERENTIAL: the port keeps the method so a strong reference does not crash, and the harness must not call it because calling +[NSFileProviderManager addDomain:completionHandler:] on the host would ask this machine to mount a provider domain. A name here is matched as an EXACT nm symbol, not a substring, so a name that is not carried is reported missing rather than quietly satisfied by a longer method.
